state.persona: Matt, back home in New York the day after his 6-day Lisbon trip ended (trip dates Fri Sep 18 → Wed Sep 23; today Thu Sep 24). Opens dope.travel to look at photos/plan his next trip.
state.job_to_be_done: Understand the state of his trip and what to do next (next trip, memories).
state.workflow_state: Opens the trip page the day after the trip ended.
state.visible_text: Header: PORTUGAL · FRI, SEP 18 → WED, SEP 23 · 5 NIGHTS / Lisbon / Underway / ENJOY EVERY MINUTE / Drafted on this device · 0 loves so far. Then: Voting as Matt / Sam, Curated / Group faves, All / Loved / Matt: to vote, New trip. Then a panel 'LISBON, RIGHT NOW — Real places and recent posts, pulled live…'. Then 'Live music for your crew in Lisbon … IN LISBON ON YOUR DATES'. The 'Right now' card that showed during the trip is gone, with no message.

thinks_ongoing.instructions: Probability the header makes Matt think the app believes his trip is still in progress.

clear_next.instructions: How clear is what Matt should do next with this app?
criteria: Clear: a wrap-up and a next step
